evidence: topic.rs derives Deserialize for a String newtype while parse alone validates dotted ASCII namespace; EditorMessageDeliveryPayload derives Deserialize and nests EditorTopic. Full editor source/test scan found only builtin/parse production construction and no external decoding consumer.
impact_or_question: Should serialized messages require validated topic names at decoding? Present derive allows invalid names but no current external call chain establishes a runtime failure.
next_action: Specify the trusted/untrusted serialization boundary; if validation is required, implement validated Deserialize and add boundary rejection tests in a behavior-change task.

evidence: registration.rs:117-125 retains successful Disabled in the same report; manager/state.rs:262-275 and :342-365 permits Disabled→Active and records Enabled without clearing old Disabled; publication.rs:58-76 calls retire_replaced_active_entries on replacement; lifecycle_replacement.rs:81 skips a stage if ever succeeded.
impact_or_question: After Active→Disabled(success)→Active on the same plugin object, replacing that active instance skips its current Disabled callback and proceeds to Unloaded, violating the cleanup-before-replacement contract.
next_action: Track cleanup completion per activation epoch or clear obsolete Disabled success upon re-enable; add a regression for disable→reenable→replacement before behavior repair.

evidence: host/lifecycle.rs:21-30 removes the active consumer before unsubscribe_consumer and only captures its error; :47-52 returns it without defer_remote_cleanup. host.rs:476-480 explicitly defers the same failed unsubscribe after BeginSession panic, while :557-608 clears the play session after local retirement and only flushes pending_remote_cleanup. tests/runtime_event_consumer_bounded_pump/faults.rs:324-347 checks first failure/local retirement but no retry.
impact_or_question: A transient remote unsubscribe failure during end_play_session, capability reconciliation, quarantine or contribution retirement loses the only retry handle after local state is removed. The old runtime subscription may remain until its session is destroyed, and later reconciliation/shutdown cannot retry it.
next_action: Retain failed retirement cleanup with its origin and qualified subscription in pending_remote_cleanup; add regression asserting a later reconcile/shutdown retries the same remote subscription after transient failure.

evidence: keymap_settings.rs:17 binds env_lock() directly, then :21-24 changes SETTINGS_USER_ROOT_ENV. tests/editor_event/support.rs:29-31 returns &TestEnvironmentLock; tests/support.rs:83-91 shows mutual exclusion begins only at .lock(). Other event tests call env_lock().lock().unwrap().
impact_or_question: This test does not hold a mutex while changing a process-global settings root. Concurrent editor tests may construct runtimes against the wrong root or observe the temporary override, creating flaky or misleading results.
next_action: Acquire and hold env_lock().lock().unwrap() around the environment override and runtime construction; add a concurrency-focused regression only if an existing suite can observe the isolation contract.
